title: The Gas Station Clerk Told Me Not to Look in My Back Seat #shorts #horror
description: I stopped for gas on an empty highway at 3 AM. The clerk wouldn't stop staring at my car. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: The clerk said: don't look in your back seat.

lines.text: Three AM. Empty highway. I stopped for gas.
The clerk kept staring past me, at my car.
He slid me a note. His hands were shaking.
It said: Don't look back. Just drive.
I laughed and walked back to my car.
The whole drive, the back seat creaked.
Something breathed behind me. Matching my breath.
I didn't look. I drove to the police station.
The officer opened my back door. Empty.
But muddy handprints covered the roof. From inside.
